text:
maria: Heads up — scanbot started spamming high-severity alerts for the same transitive CVE across multiple repos. Likely rate-limit/backpressure issue.

devsec-bot: [automated] 5 new alerts from trivy-runner in last 5m for CVE-2025-1234 on pkg:libfoo@1.2.3

leo: I see duplicates too. Trivy logs show 429s from our GH webhook after bursts — looks like webhook endpoint is being throttled.

shreya: Also the suppression-sync job failed repeatedly with KMS decrypt errors: "AccessDeniedException: decrypt not allowed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef12". Might be the RBAC tweak from last week.

maria: Can someone check scanner service account vs KMS key policy? If decrypt is blocked, suppression metadata can't be signed and sync fails, which explains duplicates.

leo: I'll run a quick policy diff. Output excerpt: ```PolicyStatement: Effect=Allow, Action=[kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource=[arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef12]```

leo: (followup) Confirmed scanner-sa lacked kms:Decrypt on the key alias/scanner-key. I'm going to add a narrow policy granting only decrypt for the scanner principal.

opsbot: deploy-bot: failover to secondary-trivy-pool initiated due to queue_length > 500 — routing traffic to runner-b.

shreya: To reduce noise I propose suppressing duplicate transitive matches for the same package digest within a 24h window, and tagging suppression entries with author + justification. I'll prepare a suppression-cleanup PR.

maria: Context for prioritization: CVE-2025-1234 CVSS 7.8, but only appears in a transitive test helper in most repos. SRE says exploitability in prod is low. Recommend schedule for next weekly dependency roll unless we see active exploit telemetry.

leo: Created PR for both fixes: KMS policy change + suppression rule tweak — https://git.company/repo/pulls/4523. Includes a tiny trivy config change to backoff on 429s: ```--retry 5 --retry-delay 2s```

shreya: Also adding audit-log fields so compliance can see: suppression_author, suppression_reason, kms_key_alias, and operation_ts. Need that before we mark suppressions as permanent.

maria: Action items:
- leo: update KMS key policy and deploy scoped change (short-lived key grant).
- shreya: land suppression-cleanup PR and add audit fields.
- maria: update triage board and set patch window; escalate if exploit seen.

maria: Thanks team. If alerts spike again, we'll open an incident channel. :thumbsup:

devsec-bot: [automated] scanbot status: queue_length decreased, alerts rate normalized — monitoring for 30m.
